annotations.text:
Smart Kitchen — key screens in the ratified design direction (docs/design/design-direction.md).
Warm parchment neutrals · terracotta kept scarce (CTA, active nav, scan button) · Inter with tabular numerals.
Provenance badges: green = Known Fact, amber = Estimated, purple = AI Interpretation.
Red appears exactly once in the whole app — the allergen block on screen 3.
